changes.comment: Add `packages/dreamux-utils/src/fs.ts` with a shared `writeAtomic(dir, filename, data, mode?)` helper (tmpfile + O_CREAT|O_EXCL + rename, default mode 0o600) and re-export it from the package barrel index. Previously this helper lived inside `@excitedjs/feishu-channel` (v3 pairing-code access gate); hoisting it lets downstream packages share the same atomic-write primitive without copying. Future filesystem primitives (safe tmpdir, safe unlink) belong in this module rather than the sibling `os.ts` module (process/signal/directory-enforcement primitives).
